lead: A fresh git worktree has no `editors/vscode/node_modules`, so `nv verify`'s `extension` step fails with hundreds of `TS2591 Cannot find name 'node:fs'` errors.
body: The dependencies are git-ignored and installed per checkout, so the main checkout's copy does not reach a worktree. Run `npm.cmd ci --prefix editors/vscode --no-audit --no-fund` once in the worktree, which installs what `editors/vscode/package-lock.json` pins, and verify again.
